      Contact us

      Our staff are here to help you. Visit The University of Western Australia's main Crawley campus, located just 10 minutes from Perth City on the banks of the Swan River, or contact us.

      General information

      UWA Perth

      Phone: +61 8 6488 6000

      Enquiries: askUWA or view our Frequently Asked Questions

      Postal address: The University of Western Australia, 35 Stirling Highway, Perth WA, 6009 Australia

      Campus map: UWA Perth

      Key contacts and enquiries

      • Emergencies

        For life threatening emergencies call 000 (police, fire, ambulance)

        • For general enquiries and emergencies phone: +61 8 6488 2222
        • SMS: 0438 739 744 – word limit applies (maximum 160 characters)
        • Email: [email protected]
        • Find us on campus (office hours 24/7)
        • Contact us via: SafeZone app – when you contact security using the SafeZone app, your location and details are already shared with the operator making it easier to respond to your enquiries, or an emergency situation.
        • security.uwa.edu.au
        • Emergency Procedures can be found here
